calculation_or_source: Company disclosed average original equipment at cost, or OEC, of 23.8B USD
what_it_says: URI has a very large productive fleet base that can absorb capital and generate rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: OEC is not book value, ROIC, utilization, or replacement/growth split.
next_source: OEC roll-forward by fleet class, acquisition, purchases, disposals, and region

source_detail: SEC 10-K annual baseline and Q2 2026 earnings-release exhibit
calculation_or_source: 23.8B USD Q2 2026 OEC - 22.48B USD FY2025 OEC
what_it_says: URI increased fleet scale by about 1.32B USD after year-end 2025.
what_it_does_not_say: The increase can reflect mix, inflation, acquisition, and replacement effects, not pure organic growth fleet.
next_source: Fleet roll-forward and category mix disclosure

calculation_or_source: Company disclosed year-to-date gross rental capital expenditures of 2.931B USD
what_it_says: URI was actively deploying capital into rental fleet during H1 2026.
what_it_does_not_say: Gross rental capex includes replacement as well as growth and does not identify asset class or funding source.
next_source: Fleet capex split between replacement and growth

metric: Payments for purchases of rental equipment
calculation_or_source: Filed cash-flow statement line for payments for purchases of rental equipment
what_it_says: The cash-flow statement confirms actual cash paid for rental equipment.
what_it_does_not_say: The line does not separate growth from replacement or identify borrowing versus internal cash funding.
next_source: Detailed capex schedule and funding-source bridge

metric: Proceeds from sales of rental equipment
calculation_or_source: Filed cash-flow statement line for proceeds from sales of rental equipment
what_it_says: Used-equipment sales recycle cash back into the fleet funding model.
what_it_does_not_say: Sale proceeds do not reveal asset condition, margin by class, or whether proceeds fund growth purchases.
next_source: Used-equipment gross margin, OEC recovery rate, and fleet age by class

calculation_or_source: 2.720B USD purchases less 680M USD sale proceeds
what_it_says: URI's net cash fleet investment after equipment recycling was 2.040B USD in H1 2026.
what_it_does_not_say: Net cash investment is not a return metric and not a growth-only investment metric.
next_source: Fleet roll-forward, depreciation, gains on sale, and growth/replacement split

metric: Operating cash flow as percent of gross rental capex
calculation_or_source: 3.305B USD year-to-date net cash provided by operating activities / 2.931B USD gross rental capital expenditures
what_it_says: URI generated operating cash flow greater than gross rental capex in H1 2026.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not prove which dollars funded which fleet purchases or whether marginal fleet returns are attractive.
next_source: Cash-flow bridge by debt draws, repayments, fleet purchases, sale proceeds, dividends, and repurchases

metric: Rental revenue as percent of OEC
what_it_says: The fleet generated quarterly rental revenue equal to about 16.2% of OEC.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not ROIC, utilization, margin, or cash return on invested capital.
next_source: Owned-equipment rental revenue, time utilization, rates, mix, and rental gross margin

calculation_or_source: Company disclosure; footnote defines fleet productivity as rental rates, time utilization, and mix on owned equipment rental revenue
what_it_says: URI gives a company-defined bridge from fleet dollars to operating output.
what_it_does_not_say: The metric is aggregated and does not disclose the rate/utilization/mix contribution split.
next_source: Fleet productivity bridge components by segment and asset class

calculation_or_source: AR securitization 1.414B; ABL 1.666B; term loan 971M; senior secured notes 2.241B; senior notes 7.582B; finance leases 356M
what_it_says: URI's funding stack is explicit and multi-layered rather than a single generic debt bucket.
what_it_does_not_say: The debt table does not allocate borrowings to specific fleet purchases or projects.
next_source: Debt maturity table, proceeds/use language, and facility agreements

metric: AR collateral pool to AR securitization borrowings
calculation_or_source: 1.779B USD receivables collateral pool net of reserves and deductions / 1.414B USD AR securitization borrowings
what_it_says: The AR securitization has a first visible collateral cushion against borrowings.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not reveal advance rates, eligibility, reserves, obligor concentration, loss, dilution, purchaser limits, or legal availability.
next_source: Receivables purchase agreement and securitization collateral reports

metric: AR excess collateral pool over borrowings
calculation_or_source: 1.779B USD receivables collateral pool net of reserves and deductions - 1.414B USD AR securitization borrowings
what_it_says: The filing gives a dollar cushion in the receivables pool after disclosed deductions.
what_it_does_not_say: The excess collateral pool is not the same as incremental borrowing availability.
next_source: Collateral report with advance rates, reserves, concentration limits, and purchaser commitments

metric: ABL drawn against stated facility size
calculation_or_source: 1.666B USD ABL balance / 4.5B USD stated ABL facility size
what_it_says: The ABL was materially drawn but not close to stated facility size on a simple stated-size basis.
what_it_does_not_say: Stated-size headroom is not legal availability because borrowing base, letters of credit, reserves, covenants, and collateral eligibility can constrain borrowing.
next_source: ABL agreement, borrowing-base certificate, L/C schedule, and availability schedule

calculation_or_source: Company disclosure; liquidity includes cash plus ABL and accounts receivable securitization facility availability
what_it_says: URI's fleet investment sits beside explicit liquidity channels tied partly to ABL and AR securitization capacity.
what_it_does_not_say: Liquidity is not use-of-proceeds proof and does not identify which facility funded which fleet purchases.
next_source: Liquidity composition, legal availability, ABL borrowing base, AR facility availability, and revolver/L/C use

calculation_or_source: 10-K states URNA payment capacity is restricted under the ABL, term loan, and note indentures and substantially all assets are subject to security interests related to existing indebtedness
what_it_says: URI's fleet-finance wrapper is covenant-bound and collateral-bound, not just balance-sheet funded.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not quantify covenant headroom, collateral coverage, restricted-payment capacity, or asset-specific liens.
next_source: ABL agreement, term-loan agreement, indentures, collateral schedules, and covenant calculations

source_file: analysis-derived from URI source-table, conversion, and filed-term rows
